<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Preparing explanation for drizzle config path**</details></think>

---

Drizzle looks for schema files relative to the process working directory (your repo root), not relative to the config file. The config was pointing to `./schema/*`, but your actual schema files live under `db/schema`, so Drizzle couldn’t find them and exited with “No schema files found”.

I updated `db/drizzle.config.ts` so both the schema glob and migrations output point at the correct paths:

```4:9:db/drizzle.config.ts
export default defineConfig({
    schema: "./db/schema/*.ts",
    dialect: "turso",
    out: "./db/migrations",
    dbCredentials: {
        url: process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL!,
        authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN!,
    },
});
```

Re-run `pnpm run migrate:generate --name init` from the project root and it should pick up `db/schema/users.ts` now.
